data.description:
## The defect

`autodeploy.sh`'s mcp store-readiness gate (step 5b) calls `record_backoff_failure` on refusal,
the REVIEW-BOT backoff recorder, instead of `record_mcp_backoff_failure` used by every other
failure branch in the mcp block (`mcp-run-failed`, `mcp-unhealthy`, `mcp-flip-failed`).

`record_backoff_failure` writes `$BACKOFF_FILE`, which gates the WHOLE script at the top, so a
storeless mcp container would suppress the review-bot deploy — a component that never ran on
that tick. `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:64-69` states that separation explicitly ("writing it
from the mcp path would let an mcp failure suppress the REVIEW-BOT deploy"), and
`MCP_BACKOFF_FILE` exists precisely to keep the two independent.

Found by the plan-review gate while reviewing `vaccinated-flavorous-solenodon` (the startup
MCP-handshake readiness gate), which was about to mirror step 5b verbatim and copy the defect.
Kept as its own ticket rather than folded in: it is a pre-existing, independently-verifiable
one-line fault in a different gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The mcp store gate's failure branch calls `record_mcp_backoff_failure`, verified by a test
      on the existing `mcp_box` harness asserting a refused storeless container writes
      `mcp-deploy-backoff` and leaves `deploy-backoff` absent.
data.title: The mcp store-readiness gate records the REVIEW-BOT backoff, throttling a component that never ran
